**Chevron's total revenue fell by about 7.3% from fiscal Q1 2023 to fiscal Q4 2023.** This is an estimate: I derived the Q4 figure rather than reading it from a filing, and some of the quarterly figures are recalled.

I used "Total revenues and other income":

| Period | Amount | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Q1 2023 | $50,836M | recalled |
| Q2 2023 | $48,891M | recalled |
| Q3 2023 | $54,083M | recalled |
| Full year 2023 | $200,949M | recalled |
| Q4 2023 | ≈ $47,139M | full year minus Q1–Q3 |

Change: (47,139 − 50,836) / 50,836 ≈ **−7.3%**

The answer depends on which revenue line is meant. If "total revenue" means "Sales and other operating revenues" instead, the Q1 figure is $48,842M. My recollection of Q4 under that line is roughly $47.2B, but that figure is uncertain and I could not reconcile it against the full-year total. On that basis the decline would be only about 3.4%.
